name: 55 — Open door lets a standard member in
description:
Same app, a third door (role-open-ws) with no rule: any logged-in user.
Bob was stopped at the premium door, but here he is welcome.
What we check: each door applies its own rule, and Bob connects.
Setup: python3.12 test-runner/scripts/setup_ep_role_scenario.py (creates the 4 doors; --reset undoes).
